articles.summary: CARSON CITY, Nev., Nov. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - BioVie Inc. (NASDAQ: BIVI) (“BioVie” or the “Company”), a clinical-stage company developing innovative drug therapies for neurological and neurodegenerative diseases, today announced the Company has been invited to present a late-breaking oral presentation at the 4th Long COVID International Conference 2026 to be held in Nice, France from November 12-13, 2026. Dr. Penelope Markham, BioVie’s Senior Vice President and Program Lead for Long COVID, will share the presentation titled “Bezisterim Improves Fatigue, Post-Exertional Malaise, and Cognition in Prespecified High-Symptom-Burden Subgroups of the Phase 2 Randomized ADDRESS-LC Trial in Long COVID” during the “Session 8: Clinical Trials” session, starting 3:30 p.m. on Friday, November 13. articles.title: BioVie Selected for Late-Breaking Oral Presentation of Bezisterim Long COVID Data at the 4th Long COVID International Conference 2026
